title: github.comment_issue
description: Add a comment to an existing issue by number on the configured repo. Params: { number: integer (the issue number), body: string (markdown, max 4000) }. Returns { ok: true, number, comment_id, url }. Denies: github_no_token (AETHER_GITHUB_TOKEN absent — the degraded capability error), github_bad_number, github_bad_body, github_api_error { status, reason } (404 status means no such issue), github_unreachable { reason }.
